text:
lara_infra: Heads-up — postmortem summary shows recurring partial responses & disconnect spikes from 2026-03-21. Trends look like a ~6h cadence, worse on client v2.1.3. Need owners for: signal analysis (noise vs regression), SDK backoff, QA harness, and rollout coordination. Prefer a weekly sweep until stable. Thoughts?

sam_platform: I'll take signal analysis. Will build a dashboard and run the queries. Initial queries I'll use:
```
COUNT(streaming.disconnects) by error_code, client_version
RATE(partial_responses[5m])
P50/P95 chunk_delivery_latency
```
Plan: dashboard by EOD Thu, alert if partial_rate > 0.8% over 5m.

devon_frontend: I'll pick up the SDK changes — proposed exp/backoff + jitter. Patch sketch:
```
backoff_ms = min(max_backoff_ms, base_ms * (1.5 ** attempts)) + random_uniform(0, jitter_ms)
```
Will open PR by Wed and add a feature flag for staged rollout.

maria_sre: I'll stand up the QA harness with synthetic streaming tests and add an SLO check. Adding alert: partial_responses / total_requests > 0.01 -> notify on-call (office hours) and Slack otherwise. Also will add a canary that pumps steady small streams.

luis_releasebot: Created issue RED-7894 and linked this thread.

sam_platform: Quick note — initial correlation shows partials spike aligning with GC pause metrics on a subset of hosts. I'll add host tags and client_version to the dashboard to validate.

devon_frontend: ack. I'll add client_version in chunk headers and a tiny telemetry ping to help correlate.

lara_infra: Owners confirmed: signal -> @sam_platform, sdk -> @devon_frontend, qa -> @maria_sre. Rollout coordination -> @maria_sre & @luis_releasebot. Weekly sweep cadence: Tue 09:30 PT. First sweep: 2026-03-31. Deliverables per sweep: dashboard link, open PR or patch notes, QA harness runbook, canary rollout plan.

maria_sre: Putting a recurring calendar invite and a public checklist in the postmortem doc. I'll summarize action items and post updates here after each sweep. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

sam_platform: Pulling logs and host metrics now, will drop dashboard link here when ready.

incbot: Postmortem RED-7894 created and assigned. Reminder: please update the issue with status after each sweep.
